actionable_steps.step: Forget all the harm done to you by others — and also forget the help you have done to others. Then you will have peace in your heart.

actionable_steps.citation: Cultivate forgiveness and love — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-01-01
actionable_steps.step: When problems and difficulties confront you, bring tolerance and an attitude of forgiveness into play — do not give rise to anger, hatred, or revenge.

actionable_steps.citation: Ganapathi Confers Buddhi And Siddhi — SSS Vol 33 (2000), 2000-09-01
actionable_steps.step: Be able to forgive even your enemies — forbearance and forgiveness are to be fostered by all.

actionable_steps.citation: Namasmarana is the Greatest Sadhana in the Kali Yuga — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-12
actionable_steps.step: Use discrimination in forgiving a cruel person — forgive once or at most twice; do not forgive him every time he harms you, otherwise you will be put to danger.

actionable_steps.citation: Fill your hearts with love of God — SSS Vol 28 (1995), 1995-04-15
actionable_steps.step: Overcome the ups and downs of life with fortitude — remain unaffected by what others may say.
Develop love for God — forgiveness is possible only by developing love for God.

definition.quote: Forget all the harm done to you by others and the help you have done to others. Then you will have peace in your heart. If someone has done harm to you, do not be revengeful. If someone has hurt your feelings, in order to alleviate your suffering, the best way is to forget and forgive. Forgiveness is very important. It is Truth, it is dharma, it is Veda, it is nonviolence, it is happiness, it is heaven itself.

discourses.citation: Cultivate forgiveness and love — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-01-01
discourses.quote: Kshama is Sathyam, Truth; Kshama is Dharma, Virtue; Kshama is Ahimsa, Non-Violence; Kshama is Yajna, Sacrifice; Kshama is Santhosha, Happiness; Kshama is Dhaya, Compassion; Kshama is everything in the world.

discourses.citation: Fill your hearts with love of God — SSS Vol 28 (1995), 1995-04-15
discourses.quote: Forgiveness is a quality that every man should possess. That forgiveness is Truth itself, it is Righteousness, it is the Veda. It is the supreme virtue in this world.

discourses.citation: Namasmarana is the Greatest Sadhana in the Kali Yuga — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-12
discourses.quote: You should forgive such a person once or at most twice. Do not forgive him every time he harms you, otherwise you will be put to danger.

discourses.citation: Ganapathi Confers Buddhi And Siddhi — SSS Vol 33 (2000), 2000-09-01
discourses.quote: Forbearance and forgiveness are the qualities which should be fostered by all individuals. You must be able to forgive even your enemies.

make_it_real: Forgiveness is heaven itself — give it freely, and heaven begins in your own heart.
title: Forgiveness

vahinis.quote: The fourth is patience or fortitude (kshama, also called sahana). It means that you should consider as unreal the evil others do unto you, the loss you suffer through them, the hatred they evince toward you. Treat these as you treat a mirage.
